description: Feature backlog - Product Owner owns priority

items.title: Add git clone install method alongside curl | bash
items.intent: Users who prefer not to pipe curl to bash have a clear, documented alternative. Both methods produce the same result.
items.description: Document a git clone install path in README.md, QUICKSTART.md, and install.sh help output. The clone method should sparse-checkout only .aishore/ into the target project, matching what the curl installer produces.
steps: Add git clone install instructions to README.md Install section
Ensure install.sh --help mentions the clone alternative
acceptanceCriteria: README.md shows git clone as an install option alongside curl
QUICKSTART.md shows git clone as an install option

acceptanceCriteria.text: Git clone method produces a working .aishore/ directory
